description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Education - Order to acquire the land in Galhinna, Poojapitiya D/S Division, Kandy District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2044/11 of 06.11.2017 for Pathadumbara Water Project
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public project. It specifically describes the acquisition of immovable property (land called "Keppitigala Estate") by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board for construction purposes. The document includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, survey plans, and claimant information, which are all characteristic of land-related gazette notifications. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and his portfolio, the core content focuses on land matters rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
